strongest_verified_result: Accepting Bi Theorem 1.1, all-angle equality for compact full-dimensional convex Euclidean polytopes against ambient-smooth face-preserving Euclidean competitors with ambient-smooth inverse and nonnegative facet mean curvature; n>=3 by theorem application, n=2 by independent turning proof, n=1 vacuous.
scope_limit: No reduction proved for weak stratum/interior-smooth, corner-singular, or merely combinatorial competitors. The 2013 ambient definition supports but does not erase the qualifier in interpreting the 2017 wording.
new_countermodels: Degenerate weak square map; two combinatorially equivalent pentagonal pyramids with linearly inequivalent apex cones under all ten incidence maps; flat nonlinear competitor with a negative face mean curvature.
